registration.description: How users can join the space

tools.title: Search for activities
tools.description: Search activities (Also Known As 'posts'), with optional filters for query text, space and favorites.

tools.name: get_activities
tools.title: Get space activities
tools.description: Retrieve a paginated list of activities (Also Known As 'posts') in a space (or all activities if space_id is null).

tools.title: Get activities of last days
tools.description: Retrieve a paginated list of activities (Also Known As 'posts') in a space (or all activities if space_id is null). This will return the posted activities since the number of designated 'days'.

tools.title: Get an activity

tools.name: get_activity_comment
tools.title: Get an activity comment
tools.description: Get a specific comment on an activity.

tools.name: create_activity
tools.title: Post an activity
tools.description: Create a new activity (Also Known As 'post') in a space activity stream (or personal activity stream if space_id is null).

tools.name: update_activity
tools.title: Update an activity
tools.description: Update an existing activity (Also Known As 'post') by its ID.

tools.name: delete_activity
tools.title: Delete an activity
tools.description: Delete an activity (Also Known As 'post') by its ID.

tools.name: pin_activity
tools.title: Pin an activity in stream
tools.description: Pin an activity (Also Known As 'post') by its ID in the stream UI.

tools.name: unpin_activity
tools.title: Unpin an activity from stream
tools.description: Unpin an activity (Also Known As 'post') by its ID.

tools.name: get_activity_comments
tools.title: Get activity comments
tools.description: Retrieve a paginated list of comments for an activity (Also Known As 'post').

tools.name: create_activity_comment
tools.title: Post an activity comment
tools.description: Add a new activity's comment to an activity.

tools.name: update_comment
tools.title: Update an activity comment
tools.description: Update an existing activity's comment by its ID.

tools.name: share_activity_to_space
tools.title: Share an activity to a space
tools.description: Share an activity (Also Known As 'post') to another space.

tools.name: get_activity_likers
tools.title: Get activity likers
tools.description: Get a paginated list of users who liked an activity (Also Known As 'post').

tools.name: like_the_activity
tools.title: Like an activity
tools.description: Like an activity (Also Known As 'post') by its ID.

tools.name: unlike_the_activity
tools.title: Un-like an activity
tools.description: Remove your like from an activity (Also Known As 'post') by its ID.

tools.name: get_category_tree
tools.title: Get the contents categorization tree
tools.description: get the available categories tree (including sub categories) which can be associated any type of content identified by its technical identifier. The returned category will describe either current user can manage contents association to the category (add/remove contents to the category) through the attribute `can_add_content`.

tools.name: get_categories_of_content
tools.title: Get categories of a content
tools.description: get the associated categories to a designated content. The returned category will describe either current user can manage contents association to the category (add/remove contents to the category) through the attribute `can_add_content`.

content_type.description: Content Type: can be extracted from expressions like `/{content_type}:{content_id}`. Use the tool `get_content_types` to list them all if you don't know the exact content type name.

content_id.description: Content Id: can be extracted from expressions like `/{content_type}:{content_id}`

tools.name: add_content_to_category
tools.title: Associate  a category to a content
tools.description: Add a content into a category. The current user must have the permission (see `can_add_content` attribute in the category) to be able to make the operation on his/her behalf.

content_type.description: Content Type: can be extracted from expressions like `/{content_type}:{content_id}`. Use the tool `get_content_types` to list them all if you don't know the exact content type name.

content_id.description: Content Id: can be extracted from expressions like `/{content_type}:{content_id}`

tools.name: remove_content_from_category
tools.title: Remove a category to a content
tools.description: Removes a content from an associated category. The current user must have the permission (see `can_add_content` attribute in the category) to be able to make the operation on his/her behalf.

content_type.description: Content Type: can be extracted from expressions like `/{content_type}:{content_id}`. Use the tool `get_content_types` to list them all if you don't know the exact content type name.

content_id.description: Content Id: can be extracted from expressions like `/{content_type}:{content_id}`
